AddParameter(string, string)

Add a new parameter to this request. Replaces any existing parameter with the same name.

If this request's osu.Framework.IO.Network.WebRequest.Method supports a request body (POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH), a osu.Framework.IO.Network.RequestParameterType.Form parameter will be added; otherwise, a osu.Framework.IO.Network.RequestParameterType.Query parameter will be added. For more fine-grained control over the parameter type, use the osu.Framework.IO.Network.WebRequest.AddParameter(System.String,System.String,osu.Framework.IO.Network.RequestParameterType) overload.

osu.Framework.IO.Network.RequestParameterType.Form parameters may not be used in conjunction with osu.Framework.IO.Network.WebRequest.AddRaw(System.IO.Stream).
